jobs.occupation: Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus
jobs.description:
R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

• Ability to communicate in English and Danish or Swedish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

About The Job

As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.

• Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.

• Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.

• Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

• Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our Director, BU Controlling (f/m/d) and help shape the financial performance and strategic direction of a global business. This role offers flexibility to be based at a Danfoss Power Solutions location within the European time zone, enabling close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our global organization.

Partnering closely with the VP of the Valves & Pumps (VPS) Business Unit, you will drive transparency across performance, profitability, and risk, turning financial complexity into actionable insights that support confident decision-making and **profitable growth.

**You will also help build and develop a high-performing global controlling community, strengthening financial capabilities across the organization while supporting business performance through coaching, governance, and matrix leadership.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive business performance through financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic planning that enables better decisions and profitable growth

• Challenge business and plant leaders with data-driven insights, helping identify opportunities, improve profitability, and mitigate risks

• Coach and develop controllers across a global matrix organization, strengthening capabilities and fostering a high-performing controlling community

• Provide clear visibility into financial performance, ensuring accurate reporting and transparency across key business metrics

• Strengthen financial governance, controls, and continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and long-term value creation

**What We're Looking For

**

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• Proven track record of driving business performance through controlling, finance business partnering, or finance leadership within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment

• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and risk management

• Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders while building trusted relationships across a global matrix organization

• Experience coaching and developing finance professionals, strengthening capabilities, and driving results through influence and collaboration

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you join a purpose-driven company committed to driving sustainable transformation and long-term growth. In this role, you will work closely with senior leaders and influence decisions that shape the direction and performance of a global business.

You will be part of a highly skilled, international finance community, with opportunities to influence senior stakeholders, contribute to global initiatives, and strengthen both people and organizational capabilities.

**Furthermore

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining financial leadership with real business impact, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your perspective, experience, and ambition could be exactly what we're looking for.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

**A Close-Knit team – and a One-Stop-Shop for Pioneering HR Solutions

**We would like to invite you into a collaborative and inclusive environment where each member is a vital part of our success. Our culture is laid-back yet professional, with room for a good laugh and a shared commitment to excellence. This can be felt all the way to our clients, who often talk about the enjoyable and effective partnerships they have with us.

“We’re proud of being a comprehensive solution for all things HR – from SuccessFactors and support to strategic HR advisory. And as part of the larger NTT DATA Business Solutions network, we can leverage cutting-edge AI technology, ensuring our clients receive the most advanced and efficient solutions available,” says Danny Haschke, SuccessFactors Consultant.

**Innovative Employee Central Implementation with ready2run®

**As a Senior Employee Central Consultant, you will lead large, international and complex implementations, taking ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design through deployment. ready2run® builds on our preconfigured starting solution, proven delivery framework and the way we shape implementation projects and customer offerings.

**Specifically, You Will

**

• Translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Help customers benefit from our ready2run® approach – both as a methodology and a mindset.

• Play an important part in strengthening our collective capability by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration across projects and helping junior consultants grow their confidence and expertise.

**Combine your strong technical expertise with your business understanding

**In this role, you will need a proactive focus on quality, detail and delivery, using your critical thinking skills and experience in resolving complex technical and functional issues in a timely and effective manner. Also, you possess a genuine desire to guide, challenge and develop colleagues, review work and share practical knowledge – and you can do so constructively in international teams. Moreover, with your strong communication skills, you engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build trusted relationships with colleagues and clients alike.

Finally, we know nobody is perfect, but we imagine that you may:

• Have several years of hands-on experience configuring and implementing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.

• Have proven experience leading large, international and complex implementations, with ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design to deployment.

• Possess strong Employee Central solution knowledge, combined with the ability to analyze HR processes and translate business priorities into practical, scalable design.

• Be open to travelling and working on diverse projects, adapting to new challenges and environments.

• Be fluent in English (this is required), with additional Scandinavian languages being a plus.

• The role can be based in any Nordic country, with the expectation that you are within practical daily commuting distance of one of our local offices.

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**Applicants are assessed continuously, so do not wait! Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career with us at NTT DATA Business Solutions. We are excited to welcome you and see what we can achieve together.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity. We proudly embrace people from all walks of life, regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or background. Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and create a richer, more creative work environment for everyone.

_At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 19,000 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

_We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ _billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

__With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

_NTT DATA Business Solutions: Make this the place where Y__ou grow.

jobs.occupation: Følsgaard is looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager – MarineTech
jobs.description:
Do you build the kind of customer relationships where trust makes the difference?

At MarineTech, we are looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager who will take responsibility for a small portfolio of key customers and ensure an excellent customer experience from agreement to delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on hunting for new business. Your success will come from knowing your customers, understanding their needs and business, and building strong, long-term relationships based on trust, reliability and professional advice.

Your role

You will be the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor, working closely with colleagues, suppliers and partners to make sure everything comes together.

You will combine customer relationship management with hands-on responsibility for orders, forecasts and deliveries. This means staying close to your customers, anticipating their needs and ensuring that commitments are followed through.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Build, maintain and develop strong relationships with existing customers

• Act as the customer’s primary contact and advise on products, solutions and delivery options

• Manage orders from A to Z, including requirements, prices, terms, documentation and delivery

• Follow up on customer forecasts and coordinate internally to support material and delivery planning

• Coordinate closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams

• Proactively keep customers informed about quotations, orders, deliveries and deviations

• Maintain accurate customer, order and activity data in ERP and CRM

• Identify opportunities to further develop existing customer accounts

• Look forward to 10–15 travel days per year as an opportunity to meet customers, build stronger relationships and get closer to their business.

You probably have experience from B2B customer management, order coordination, sales or customer service. More importantly, you enjoy building relationships and creating a customer experience where people know they can rely on you.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience working with B2B customers and coordinating orders or deliveries

• Have a good commercial understanding and an interest in technical products and solutions

• Are comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems and structured follow-up

• Ideally have experience coordinating with suppliers, carriers and complex deliveries

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English

As a person

You are outgoing and approachable and naturally create good relationships with customers and colleagues. You are service-minded without losing sight of the commercial perspective.

At the same time, you are structured and proactive. You take ownership, keep an overview when several things are happening at once, and make sure agreements and commitments are followed through to completion.

Why this role?

You will get a role where relationships matter. Rather than constantly chasing the next customer, you will have the opportunity to understand a smaller number of important customers in depth and become a trusted partner in their day-to-day business.

You will be close to both customers and the internal organization, giving you a central role in turning customer needs into reliable solutions and deliveries.

Interested?

If you want to help develop the specialized container and maritime transport industry – while developing yourself professionally and personally – then we look forward to hearing from you.

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. Interviews are held continuously and we will hire once we find the right candidate.

If you have questions, feel free to contact HR Manager Louise Buur at +45 21 20 44 67.

**About Hans Følsgaard (**Hans Følsgaard A/S)

Hans Følsgaard A/S is a global technology company with roots in engineering and a clear ambition to support the green transition through intelligent, reliable solutions. Since 1922, we have provided specialised technology expertise to industry, and our team of more than 120 employees is based across locations in Denmark, Norway, Germany, India and China.

Collaboration, accountability and integrity are at the heart of how we work. We operate with flat organisational structures, take a long-term perspective and value curiosity, professional expertise and initiative.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Sales Operations Specialist to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist who wants to make a difference.

The Role

As a Sales Operations Specialist, you will support the sales organization and other parts of Truesec through sales administration and the coordination of sales-related processes. The role is central to ensuring that our sales operations run smoothly, efficiently, and in line with internal processes, policies, and business requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with a variety of functions across the organization, including Sales, Finance, Legal, Expert Services, and Managed Services. You will play an important part in driving structure, quality, and efficiency throughout our business and customer-facing processes.

As the first Sales Operations Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to shape and develop the role locally while being part of an established team based in Stockholm and Malmö. The role includes occasional travel to our Swedish offices to support collaboration and team development.

Examples of responsibilities:

• 
Create and administer offers, agreements, and digital signing.

• 
Manage deal registrations, incoming communication, and administrative follow-up.

• 
Set up and administer projects in Visma.

• 
Support Finance with data and processes to ensure accurate and efficient invoicing.

• 
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and quality-assured sales processes.

Your Potential Background

We believe you are structured, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a strong ability to combine administration, coordination, and business understanding. You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy creating structure, driving initiatives forward, and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and accuracy.

You are comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously, have a strong attention to detail, and communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

We believe you have:

• 
Experience from a similar role within Sales Operations, sales support, administration, or business coordination.

• 
Strong organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously.

• 
The ability to analyze information and translate insights into documentation, reports, and recommendations that support decision-making and follow-up.

• 
Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

It is an advantage if you have:

• 
Experience working with Visma, Jira, or similar finance or administration systems.

• 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Finance, and Legal teams in business-critical processes.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

jobs.occupation: Student assistants for Digital Archives and Methods, spring 2027
jobs.description:
Introduction to Digital Archives and Methods is a moderately computationally intensive standalone course in History BA.

This course is scheduled on Tuesdays 8 -12 and Thursdays 10 - 14 in weeks 6 - 20. The bulk of assistance is needed in Weeks 6 - 15 in a minimum of 4 hr intervals. Each class is attended by circa 50-60 students who work in groups to complete digital tasks. The course is in-person.

We are looking for 2 teaching student assistants who can support the learners in this course through troubleshooting, assistance and conceptual guidance on the main tasks and themes of the course.

The tasks of the assistants are to provide in-class/remote assistance (in class-time):

· setup:

• assist with local software installations or online instantiations of Voyant, Transkribus, UCloud, R, OpenRefine, etc.

• access to course sources and computational environments

· operation:

• help students operate the tools introduced in the course and

• guide students in the pursuit of course tasks. Help interpret tool outputs during the conceptual work towards assessments.

• Act as student liaisons, translating student needs into technical questions for the instructors.

Selected candidates should show initiative, be digitally savvy and enthusiastic as well as reliable and well-organized. The work requires independence, flexibility, and attention to detail. Furthermore, the candidate should have good interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate's application should demonstrate the following qualifications:

• Good command of English and Danish, both oral and written

• Familiarity with the course materials as well as the digital tools introduced: previous attendance of Digital Archives and Methods or equivalent is recommended.

• Experience with troubleshooting code and a knack for digital problem-solving

• Proactive, motivated and enthusiastic attitude

• Ability to communicate effectively with students and fellow assistants, as well as liaise with instructors.

Please contact Kathrine Juul Svejstrup kjs@cas.au.dk for more information about the positions.

Applications should address how the applicant fits the qualifications listed above, be written in English and accompanied by a brief CV. Please indicate your availability in class time in weeks 6 to 15 and state which operating systems you are comfortable troubleshooting.

A prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is an actively enrolled student. Employment is subject to the availability of the necessary funding.

Applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application within four weeks of the application deadline.

Terms of Employment

Employment is in accordance with the Ministry of Finance and SUL Finansministeriet og SUL (student instructors).

The application must include a copy of your diploma and any documentation of previous teaching experience.

Aarhus University aims to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for everyone and strives for a culture where each individual can thrive and develop. We view equality and diversity as valuable resources and therefore encourage all interested candidates to apply.

About Arts

The Faculty of Arts is one of Northern Europe’s most significant faculties for research and higher education in the humanities, theology and education. Within this broad academic scope, the faculty comprises approximately 700 researchers, 200 PhD students, 9,000 Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, and 1,500 further and continuing education students. We believe that the best ideas arise when different perspectives meet – and that research, teaching and innovation are best developed in dialogue with the surrounding society.

You can find more information here: Faculty of Arts | Aarhus Universitet

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Head of Medical Affairs International Markets
jobs.description:
Are you knowledgeable within allergy treatment? Do you like working in an international setting facing different cultures? Bring your expertise in allergy, immunology and medical strategy to a global role where your scientific leadership can make a meaningful difference.

The position

The Head of Medical Affairs International Markets will serve as a therapeutic and disease area expert who is responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy development and structured, consistent and strategically aligned medical engagement across International Markets. International Markets in ALK covers all territories outside Europe and North America. The primary focus is Asia, Middle East and Latin America. The International Markets team is small and diverse with people sitting all over the world and currently covering 12 different native languages. You will be reporting directly to SVP International Markets, Morten Essendrop.

Your Primary Tasks Will Be

Medical Strategy Development

• Responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy and plan for International Markets, leveraging learnings and best practices from Region Europe and Region US Medical Affairs.

• Ensure consistency between strategies, communication and messaging within ALK and across partners allowing for local adaption.

• Support partners with medical expertise and education on ALK products.

• Accountable for publication planning (including congress abstracts, poster presentations, manuscripts) working in close collaboration with local teams and Global Medical Affairs.

External Medical Representation

• Define stakeholder engagement strategies and develop professional relationships with thought leaders to ensure education and scientific communication on ALK products and therapeutic areas of interest. Lead scientific and external engagement strategy for International Markets.

• Represent ALK as medical expert and speaker at selected international congresses, advisory boards, partner meetings and scientific events within International Markets.

• Act as a senior medical ambassador for ALK in key International Markets.

Your profile

We expect that you are a medical doctor with the following qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of the immunology field, strong presentation skills and scientific expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with allergy treatment including allergen specific immunotherapy.

• Knowledge of Medical Affairs standards and processes.

• Ability to develop Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans.

• Build and interact with a network of allergy/immunology experts, partners and represent ALK in scientific and medical matters. Capable of conducting doctoral level discussions with key customers.

• Ability to collaborate with Global Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations functions locally and globally. Working in a matrix environment.

Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation. The result of your efforts will be significant throughout the organisation, and you will be able to actively influence and challenge the status quo.

The position is international with up to 50-60 days of travelling per year. For the ideal candidate flexibility in the workplace can be arranged.

Apply

Apply by attaching your CV and a short letter of motivation.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. Hence, we prefer that you do not add images to your application documents. We evaluate applications and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply! We reserve the right to take down the advert when we have found the right candidate.

Do you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills and experience, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics. Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring full compliance in a complex and fast-evolving regulatory landscape? As our new Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, you'll play a key role in safeguarding STG's global trade flows and reducing customs-related risk. You'll work closely with Planning, Customs & Transportation, Procurement, and Finance to keep customs processes compliant, efficient, and well-documented.

What your day will look like

• Manage and follow up on import and export procedures to ensure compliant, timely customs flows

• Monitor and implement customs legislation changes and country-specific obligations

• Set up and oversee customs regimes such as EMCS (Excise Movement and Control System), IPR (Inward Processing Relief), and bonded warehouse processes

• Classify products and determine valuation and origin (HS – Harmonized System, ECS – Export Control System, FTA – Free Trade Agreement) for accurate declarations and duty management

• Support SAP-based customs processes as a basic user (training provided)

• Conduct regular risk assessments and manage customs claims, with proactive mitigation and clear documentation

Keystakeholders

Material Planning · Customs & Transportation · Procurement · Finance · Manufacturing · Tax/Legal · IT/Reporting · SST · Warehousing

What you'll bring

• Proven experience in customs & trade compliance, including hands-on work with import/export processes and customs regimes

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in declarations and documentation

• Analytical ability to interpret and apply legislation

• Proactive, service-oriented mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills

• Danish language proficiency and valid Danish ID Card

• Working proficiency in English

Nice-to-have: Descartes software experience

• Advantage: experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator), UCC (Union Customs Code), CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism), EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation), or customs audits

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

Delivering software excellence and pushing the limits of technology to make some of the world’s best hearing aids is what we do in Demant.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with broad competencies who wants to develop and strengthen our Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL).

You will be deep down the software stack in a crucial and complex part of our software eco system.

Development, defect support and platform improvements

Our HAL platform connects to hearing aids, apps, fitting software and sophisticated internal tools. Seamless Bluetooth solutions and connectivity are crucial for the end-users to have great experience with our hearing aids.

We embrace agile software development and use Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and releases the HAL platform 2-4 times per year. The backlog of features and enablers are executed by priority.

The features are platform support of audiological or end user features. The enablers are typically platform improvements for the future and general internal improvements that can be either specific or of an exploratory nature.

What you will do

Your job can be divided into these three main areas:

• 
Most of your daily life is analyzing, designing, coding, testing and integrating our platform, always done with a broad mindset. Analyzing logs and unraveling mysteries is a key activity in the role and team.

• 
With an ever-changing Bluetooth environment and incoming defects there will be adjustments, which you must react fast to as part of the team. You will also act as problem solver for other teams consuming HAL.

• 
Lastly, you will be part of simplifying HAL to make the solutions more effective, maintainable and secure. In collaboration with the team, you will identify improvements and come up with suggestions for how these should be implemented.

We need everybody in the team to be on top of technology to keep on improving and providing best-in-class solutions. To support this, we have a monthly learning day for the team to acquire relevant knowledge either individually or on a team base.

We invest in and take advantage of AI, that is part of our development environment and tooling.

Teamwork, teamwork, teamwork

Part of your team consists of six Software Developers, two Test Developers, a Product Owner and a Scrum Master. They are all very experienced and enthusiastic about their jobs.

We encourage and strive for T-shaping, meaning that it is healthy that we share the responsibilities and grow mutual skills between developers and test developers.

Scrum is used as the basic way of working and encourages collaboration, sparring and sharing of thoughts and enables the best possible solutions.

It is important that you can collaborate with others and see the gain of it, rather than just working on your own. We hope that you, with your energy and enthusiasm, will contribute and encourage cooperation.

Your manager is a “servant leader” and will support your needs and development in our trust-based culture.

We believe in the good life

In Demant we trust and value professionalism, experience, and commitment. We recognize that to bring energy and inspiration to work, you need to re-energize and spend time with family, friends, and hobbies in a healthy work life balance.

To ensure the good life we offer good breakfast and lunch in our canteen, free fitness room including weekly spinning and yoga sessions, massage offer, no child’s first sick day meaning you can stay home with your child as long as the child is not feeling well and the possibility to work from home up to two days per week. Just to mention some of the things.

Your profile

• To candidate for this job, you need to be Senior Software Developer with minimum 8 years of experience. You have experience with hardware abstraction layers either as a provider or consumer.

• You are proficient in .NET and #C and have experience with Bluetooth Low Energy and/or have made apps; IOS, Android or MAUI, and are able to grasp, navigate and make a difference in a large eco-system of software and hardware.

• You like to understand how things work and to untangle complex issues in the complex HAL world.

• It will be nice but is not required if you have experience from pharma / medico or other regulated industries and know how it impact our work.

• Other people will say you have a high focus on quality and testing at all levels and that you enjoy the respect of others as a team player, where you seek the optimal solution through a constructive dialogue.

• It is required that you work on-site Smørum from 1st of January 2027 and no later than 1st of February 2027.

Interested in our exciting position? - Deadline is the 8th of November 2026.

Submit CV and a short, focused motivation in English reflecting the profile above.

We expect to hold the 1st interview on the 16th and 18th of November, and the 2nd interview on the 23rd and 24th of November.

Applications are only accepted via our online platform. We do not respond to inquiries from external suppliers.

Senior Manager, Group Development & Strategy

Help shape Coloplast’s growth agenda by sourcing, evaluating and executing strategic transactions across our global business.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager to join Group Development & Strategy at our headquarters in Humlebæk. The role will have a primary focus on M&A while also contributing to selected enterprise strategy projects. You will help develop Coloplast’s M&A agenda, build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities across our business segments, support the M&A Director on key priorities and independently lead selected projects.

The transaction scope spans acquisitions, divestments, minority equity investments and strategic partnerships, as well as integration planning. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to senior leaders, business segments, global functions and external advisers.

Welcome to Group Development & Strategy

You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Together, we work across group strategy, strategic projects, transactions and post-merger integration, collaborating closely with Executive Leadership and teams across the organisation. You will become part of a distinctive performance culture focused on working together to achieve the best results.

Your key responsibilities includes

•    Support the development of the enterprise M&A strategy and strategic priorities across our business units

•    Source opportunities and maintain the pipeline across acquisitions, divestments, equity investments and partnerships

•    Assess potential targets, including strategic fit, value and key risks, in collaboration with internal stakeholders

•    Support the M&A Director on key transactions and independently lead selected processes

•    Prepare financial models, valuations and business cases

•    Coordinate due diligence across relevant functions

•    Manage relationships with targets, owners and external advisers

•    Support integration planning and the handover to the business

•    Prepare proposals and recommendations for senior management and other internal stakeholders

•    Monitor market, competitor and transaction trends relevant to Coloplast

•    Support on selected enterprise strategy and integration projects

What we expect from you:

•    A relevant commercial master’s degree or MBA

•    5–6 years of experience within M&A and ideally with strategic projects

•    Experience from top-tier consulting, investment banking and/or private equity

•    Strong financial and business modelling skills and hands-on M&A execution capabilities

•    Experience across all phases of a transaction

•    Experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

•    Fluent written and spoken English

•    Experience working in an international environment

•    Experience from healthcare or medical devices industry is an advantage, but not a requirement

How you work

You are intellectually curious and comfortable moving between the big picture and detailed analysis. You create momentum in ambiguous situations, challenge constructively and know when to involve others. You build trust across functions and geographies, remain composed under pressure and balance analytical thoroughness with the pace required in live transactions.

Role details

Team: Group Development & Strategy

You will work closely with the team and the Product Owner to align with stakeholders and ensure a seamless customer journey, and you will be part of a modernization at the very core of the bank.

We are looking for a Senior Java Software Engineer who enjoys translating business needs into scalable and secure technical solutions. As a squad, we are exploring how AI agents and tools can enhance our development processes, ways of working and the value we deliver. You will help shape this journey by turning promising ideas into practical improvements for the team.

Working closely with your colleagues, you will contribute throughout the development lifecycle – from understanding and refining requirements to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support – with efficiency and quality at the heart of everything we do.

You will

• Contribute to solutions throughout the development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and handover to end users.

• Apply your experience to solve complex technical challenges, share knowledge and support colleagues in delivering strong outcomes.
